notes.title: BETA version will be published this month!!
notes.notes:
The first BETA version of The Simple Balance will be available later this month!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42006725/d5b77e0edb7412cdf2fc383d6aae05e9865bb8cf.png"]
It's a first beta version of the game — but it's fully playable, and we’re excited to finally share it with you.
Your feedback is more than welcome and will help shape the future of the game!

This version only supports 16:9 resolutions!!! 

Thank you for being part of this journey!
